# FDG9132

> DO NOT return error codes to indicate timeout expiration.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.10 Timeouts.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a return value reports that a timeout expired is what it means. FDG7001 is the general rule against error codes.

## From the book

Expiration of a timeout means the operation could not complete successfully and thus should be treated and handled as any other runtime error (see Chapter 7).
